semantics: optional EntropyFS persistence substrate (master brief §1/§31/§45/§46, ADR-0004). (1) ObjectStore abstraction: get/put/contains + unique_count/unique_payload_bytes/physical_bytes/sync/close; implementations EmbeddedStore (in-crate content-addressed append-only log: one record per distinct payload [cid 32][len u64][payload], hash-gated reads, named snapshot roots under roots/, mark-compact GC) and EntropyFsStore (feature entropyfs-store, default OFF: adapter over the published entropyfs embeddable engine put/get/contains/sync/compact/metrics with engine BlobId == VOLE content id == BLAKE3 of the same bytes). Sharing is by exact canonical-record identity only - never appearance. Payload kinds: object canonical records (identity::content_id_of) and palette-table snapshots (kind prefix 0xE0, collision-free by construction); rANS model tables and dictionary tables are not first-class v1 tables yet (recorded open surface). (2) Archive publish: publish_stream extracts every immutable object + palette-table snapshot of a standalone stream into the store and reports per-stream declared attribution; archive_accounting reports actual store-level physical cost vs declared attribution separately (shared state is never zeroed; dedup_saved = declared - unique payload). (3) Wire extension (additive, old streams re-parse unchanged): TAG_OBJECT_EXTERN 0x09 + header feature bit FEAT_EXTERNAL_OBJECTS 0x1; a stream that references store-held canonical records by content id is deliberately NOT standalone (store-less decode = StoreRequired; unknown bits fail closed; bit-without-extern and extern-without-bit are non-canonical). encode_stream_external / decode_with_store resolve references through the ObjectStore; each fetched record's digest is re-verified against the declared content id (IntegrityMismatch) and re-parsed via Object::from_canonical_record, so the materializer never learns an object's provenance.

Old golden streams carry feature_bits == 0 and re-parse unchanged.

EntropyFsStore.unique_payload_bytes maps to the engine's physical.live_bytes (root-reachable canonical record bytes) and is advisory for byte-exact courts; exact payload-level accounting is asserted on the EmbeddedStore whose layout VOLE owns (engine physical numbers remain reported honestly).
Standalone invariance: no embedded stream requires a store; the full pre-Phase-P suite (205 tests) passes unchanged alongside the 13 new courts.

Materializer provenance: extern references are resolved at parse into ordinary Objects (digest-verified), so replay/materialization never touches the store; the materializer cannot tell file-resident from store-resident objects.

Recorded boundaries: model/dictionary tables are not first-class v1 tables yet (their sharing is open surface); interval palette mutations stay per-stream timeline state (only initial palette-table snapshots publish); `vole optimize` rejects store-backed streams typed (no silent rewrite of a non-standalone stream).
